wargear.name: Arkanic Destroyer Frame
wargear.text:
A model that has an Arkanic Destroyer Frame gains the Bulky (3) and Hardwired for Destruction Special Rules and the Destroyer Trait. When selecting an Arkanic Destroyer Frame during army creation, the controlling player may additionally select one of the following options to apply to the model by paying additional point cost on top of the points cost paid to select the Arkanic Destroyer Frame:
• Free: The model's Movement Characteristic is changed to 8.
• +10 points: The Model's Unit Type is changed to Cavalry. It gains the Antigrav and Heavy Sub-Types and its Movement Characteristic is changed to 12.
• +15 points: The model gains the Deep Strike and Phase Motion Special Rules and the Phase Shift Trait. Its Movement Characteristic is changed to 10.

wargear.name: Containment Field
wargear.text:
When a model with a Containment Field is allocated an unsaved Wound or Penetrating Hit, the Damage Characteristic of the Unsaved Wound or Penetrating Hit is halved, rounded up.

If the Explodes (X) Special Rule of a model with a Containment Field triggers, any Hits inflicted by the Explodes Special Rule gain the Breaching (4+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Canoptek Familiar
wargear.text: The Controlling Player of a Model with a Canoptek Familiar can modify the results of Intelligence Checks made for that Model by -2.

wargear.name: Dispersion Shield
wargear.text: A model with a Dispersion Shield has a 4+ Invulnerable Save, gains the Heavy Sub-Type, and gains the Shield Trait.

wargear.name: Gloom Prism
wargear.text: A model with a Gloom Prism, as well as all Models from the same Army within 12", gain the Adamantium Will (5+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Nebuloscope
wargear.text: When a Shooting Attack made by a model with a Nebuloscope inflicts any Hits (including Hits from attacks made a Snap Shots), Shrouded Damage Mitigation Rolls cannot be made against those Hits.

wargear.name: Phase Shifter
wargear.text: A model with a Phase Shifter has a 4+ Invulnerable save and gains the Phase Shift Trait.

wargear.name: Oracular Targeter
wargear.text:
Once per Shooting Phase, the controlling player of a model with an Oracular Targeter can apply one of the following to the model:
• Add 1 to the result of one Hit Test made for a Ranged Attack made by the model's Unit;
• Subtract 1 from the result of one Scatter roll made for the model's Unit.
In either case, the controlling player decides to apply the modifier or not after the roll is made.

wargear.name: Phase Shift Generator
wargear.text: Any of the controlling player's models from the Necron army list that are within 12" of a model with a Phase Shift Generator, including the model itself, gain a 5+ invulnerable save and the Phase Shift Trait.

wargear.name: Phylactery
wargear.text: At the start of each of the Controlling Player's Turn as the Active Player, if the Current Wounds Characteristic of the Model with a Phylactery is lower than its Starting Wounds Characteristic, the Controlling Player rolls a D6. If the result of the roll is greater than the Model's Current Wounds Characteristic, the Model gains 1 Wound.

wargear.name: Quantum Shielding (X)
wargear.text: A Vehicle model with the Quantum Shielding Special Rule has its Armour Value (on all facings) counted as the value associated with the specific variant of this special rule attached to the model, so long as its Current Hull Points characteristic is equal to its Starting Hull Points characteristic.

wargear.name: Resurrection Orb
wargear.text:
In the controlling player's Movement Phase as the Active Player, when a Model equipped with a Resurrection Orb has been selected, but either before or after it has been moved, the controlling player of that model may activate its Resurrection Orb. When activated, the controlling player makes a number of Resurrection (5+) Tests for that model's Unit equal to the number of models that have been removed as casualties from the Unit over the course of the battle, excluding models that have joined the unit before or after the battle or were assigned to it.

Each Resurrection Orb can only be activated once per battle.

wargear.name: Sempiternal Weave
wargear.text: A model with a Sempiternal weave has a 2+ Armour Save.

wargear.name: Sense Cluster
wargear.text: A Model that is equipped with a Sense Cluster fires Snap Shots at its full Ballistic Skill. All other penalties relating to Snap Shots still apply.

wargear.name: Shadowloom
wargear.text: If a Unit that includes any Models with Shadowlooms is the target of a Shooting Attack, if the distance between the closest Model in the Attacking Unit and the Target Unit is 12" or greater, Models in that Unit gain the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule or, if they already have or gain a version of the Shrouded (X) Special Rule from another source, modify the variable number by +1 (5+ becomes 4+, etc), to a maximum of 4+.

wargear.name: Shield Vanes
wargear.text: A model with Shield vanes has its Armour Save characteristic improved by 1 step (4+ becomes 3+, etc), to a maximum of 3+.

wargear.name: Targeting Relay
wargear.text: At the start of the controlling player's Shooting Phase, a model with this special rule can select a friendly unit with the Reanimant Unit sub-Type within 12", except its own unit. Until the end of the current phase, add 1 to the result of all Hit Tests made for Ranged Attacks made by the selected Unit. This does not stack; a Unit can only receive the benefits of one Targeting Relay per phase.

wargear.name: Translocation Shroud
wargear.text: A model with a Translocation shroud, and all models with the Infantry Type in the Unit it joins, gain the Deep Strike Special Rule.

wargear.name: Whip Coils
wargear.text: During a turn in which a model with Whip Coils' Unit either succesfully completed a Charge, or itself had a Charge succesfully completed against it, all of that model's Melee Weapons receive a +3 bonus to their Initiative Modifier.
